title: Show pickup details in order confirmation (if pickup is offered)
body: If we offer local pickup at checkout (Linear RIV-5), the order confirmation needs to show the pickup time slot and the roastery address instead of the shipping line.

title: Add header art to launch announcement
body: Priya Raman is sending the header illustration for the Nov 10 launch email. Add it as a hosted image with alt text, and test it in Gmail and Outlook before Dana Whitfield sends it.
